blind.description: A low stylized wooden fence or hitching rail consisting of three square posts with pyramidal caps connected by a horizontal rail. Tied around the horizontal rail between the center post and one outer post is a coiled or knotted rope with dangling ends. The wood has an orange-brown painted/carved texture with subtle stylized grain and nail indentations, while the rope is beige/tan. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without broken shards or hovering elements.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal line formed by a narrow bar intersecting three square post caps aligned in a row, with a small wrapped ring representing the rope on one segment.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.4 times the figure's height (approx. 2.3 feet tall) and roughly 1.0 to 1.1 times the figure's height in total length (approx. 5.5 to 6 feet long).
